title: Inbound demo request — qualify use case & find a 30-min slot
text:
Inbound demo request — qualify use case & find a 30-min slot

["From: Samira Khanna <samira@clarityai.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:12:34 -0800
Subject: Quick demo request — customer support summarization use case

Hi Tessa / Ben,

We signed up for the self-serve trial and I've been poking at the API — looks promising. I lead platform at ClarityAI and we'd like a short 30-minute demo to understand how Redwood handles the use case below and to see rough cost/latency tradeoffs.

High level:
- Use case: real-time support ticket summarization + routing to teams (extractive + short abstractive summary + intent classification).
- Current load: ~2–3M queries/month (mostly short text), average ~350–500 tokens/request.
- Peak concurrency: unknown but we occasionally see spikes ~70–100 req/s during campaign days.
- Timeline: hoping to start a small PoC in Jan 2027 and go to pilot by Mar 2027.
- Compliance: SOC 2 required, data retention controls important.

Can you confirm whether Redwood has a recommended starter configuration for this profile and if you can demo the platform (hosting options, latency profiles, and batching/cost levers)?

We can do a 30-min call next week — our timezone is PST. I propose Tue/Thu morning (between 9–11am PST) but we can be flexible.

Attaching a short company overview and a tiny sample of traffic metrics.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khanna
Head of Platform, ClarityAI
attachments: clarityai-overview.pdf (application/pdf), clarity_prod_metrics.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)", "From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khanna <samira@clarityai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:05:17 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — customer support summarization use case

Hi Samira — thanks for the note and the context, this is a great fit for a short demo. I'll gladly set something up. Before we lock time, a couple quick questions so we tailor the session and prep the right examples: 

1) Primary objective for PoC — quality validation (summaries), latency SLAs (sub-300ms for tokens), or cost-per-output optimization?
2) Can you share a 24-hour peak qps snapshot and a sample of request/response token lengths? You attached an overview but the concurrency profile helps sizing.
3) Is the data processed PII-sensitive? Any specific security/compliance checklist items beyond SOC 2 we should prep for?
4) Region preference for hosting (us-west, us-east, eu)?
5) Who should join the call from your side? Will your CTO or engineering lead attend?
6) Do you plan to run model inference on hosted Redwood API or on a Private deployment behind VPC?

Proposed 30-minute slots (PST) — please pick one or suggest alternatives: 
- Mon 16 Nov, 10:00–10:30am 
- Tue 17 Nov, 09:00–9:30am 
- Wed 18 Nov, 11:00–11:30am

I'll loop in Ben (AE) to keep pricing and pilot ops on the thread. Attaching our quick demo intake checklist so we can capture answers during the call.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
attachments: demo-intake-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)", "From: Samira Khanna <samira@clarityai.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:22:03 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — customer support summarization use case

Thanks Tessa — answers inline below.

1) Primary objective: quality + latency. We need summaries accurate enough for human agents to take action, and latency ideally <500ms 95th. Cost is secondary for the PoC.
2) Peak qps: about 80 req/s sustained during peak 1–2 hour windows (campaign days). Typical day is ~800 qps aggregated, but most of our traffic is asynchronous.
3) Data sensitivity: personal data (user names, emails) — we will require SOC 2 + data retention options and an NDA for the pilot.
4) Region: prefer us-west for lower RTT to our infra.
5) Participants: me (Samira), our engineering manager Nikhil (cc'd on this reply), and likely our CTO for a 2nd call if we proceed.
6) Deployment: leaning hosted API to start (faster), but open to dedicated if cost/latency tradeoffs push that way.

We can do Mon 16 Nov 10:00–10:30am PST (works for our ENG manager) — I can also do Wed 18 Nov 11am PST if you prefer.

Forwarding our traffic snapshot as requested.

— Samira
attachments: clarity_prod_metrics.xlsx (small sample)

Hi Samira — Ben here (AE). Great to meet you over email. Thanks for the quick answers — Monday 16 Nov 10:00–10:30am PST works for us. I've created a calendar invite and included a short agenda: 1) 5m intros, 2) 15m demo focused on summarization & routing flow, 3) 10m Q&A / next steps.

Tessa — looping Dylan (Solutions Engineer) to help with pre-demo sizing and to prepare a short runbook for the PoC (token estimates, recommended model/quantization, and cost ranges).

Samira, next steps: 
- Please confirm the attendees (Nikhil / CTO optional).
- If you can upload a tiny anonymized sample or share the short XLSX you mentioned, Dylan will use it in sizing.

Calendly (if you'd prefer self-service booking): https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/30-min
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Invite attached. Looking forward to it.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
